issues.issue: The label reads as motor vehicle tax. Treating it as the state pro-rate allocation (state aid) is defensible for an SID and is applied consistently, but it is a judgment call. The same applies to detail[3] 'State Motor Vehicle Taxes' (p4) and detail[18] 'Motor Vehicle Tax' (p5), both coded motor vehicle pro-rate.

issues.on_page: Columns: Actual on GAAP Basis / Adjustments / Actual on Budgetary Basis / Budget
issues.issue: Detail amounts come from the budgetary-basis actual column, so they don't tie to the GAAP fund statement on p2 (for example, Maintenance is 95,912 here vs 73,997 on p2). This is defensible because that is the column compared to the budget, but it was a choice between two printed 'Actual' columns.
